champion.tips: AMUMU TIPS AND TRICKS Powerfarm and get as much XP as possible early on so you can get your Ultimate R quickly. Once you’re level 6, make sure you gank every time your Ultimate R is up. Try to gank as soon as it comes up every time to make full use of the cooldown. Once you’ve used your Ultimate R in a team fight, either stick to the enemy backline or retreat backwards and peel for your carries.
champion.builds: THE BEST AMUMU BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR JUNGLE IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Amumu Jungle build, you should take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Conqueror as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, as well as Cheap Shot and Ultimate Hunter in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Liandry's Torment as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Sunfire Aegis. For your last 3 items, you should build Abyssal Mask, Thornmail and finish with Jak'Sho, The Protean. For the skill order, you want to stick with E - Q - W. Right now, this build has 53.0% winrate over 6 611 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Aftershock as your keystone, Font of Life, Bone Plating and Unflinching in the primary tree, and Cheap Shot with Ultimate Hunter in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Liandry's Torment as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Sunfire Aegis as a third item. You want to finish the build with Abyssal Mask, Thornmail and Jak'Sho, The Protean. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it E - Q - W. This build is currently sitting at a 50.0% win rate across 600 matches played. Situational Amumu Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Amumu build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Amumu runes page.
